name: Xinxiang Hongqi Artificial Intelligence Computing Power Center Phase I
developer: Xinxiang Dongsheng Development & Construction Investment Co.; Beijing SENSORO Technology (equipment supplier)
notes: Public tender and award reports describe a Hongqi District AI computing center phase I with 70P AI compute and 8P storage; budget CNY144.53m, reported award CNY125.265735m.

name: Xinyang Artificial Intelligence Computing Center
developer: Xinyang local authorities / project company not identified in source
notes: Xinyang人大 report says delegates inspected the Xinyang AI computing center project among key projects under construction/operation; earlier reporting described about 75.46 mu site and about CNY1.7bn construction amount.

name: Yudongnan High-tech Industrial Development Zone Big Data Industrial Park
developer: Yudongnan High-tech Industrial Development Zone / Xinyang Huaxin Science and Education Creative Industrial Park
notes: Official planning-permit pre-publicity covers phase I construction; third-party project tracker classifies it as a new data-center/new-infrastructure project with construction cycle 2023-2027.

name: Bote Intelligent Henan Xinyang Intelligent Computing Center
developer: Bote Intelligent; Xinyang Economic Development Zone; Xinyang Dingxin Group Digital Industry Co.
notes: Industry report says the Xinyang intelligent computing center phase I was signed, planned for 1000P, with phase I targeted for 2024 Q2 service.

name: Xuchang Edge Cloud Computing Center Phase I Equipment Upgrade
developer: Xuchang Shitou Big Data Technology Co.; China Mobile Henan (supplier)
notes: Henan public resources award notice covers new general compute, AI compute, SDN network, storage, cloud management, deep-learning platform and operations platform; China Mobile Henan won at CNY219.04m; delivery term 150 days.

name: National Supercomputing Internet Core Node / National Supercomputing Center Zhengzhou
developer: National Supercomputing Center Zhengzhou / Sugon and partners
notes: Official/provincial reports say the National Supercomputing Center Zhengzhou has 100P Flops and 100PB storage, with 360P AI compute online in a planned 500P AI expansion; the national supercomputing internet core node in Zhengzhou was online for trial operation in 2026.

name: Henan Airport Intelligent Computing Center
developer: Zhengzhou Airport Economy Zone / project partners
notes: Zhengzhou official reporting says the center was unveiled in Zhengzhou Airport Economy Zone as the largest computing-power center in central China; later reporting says it uses A-level data-center standard with 15 modular rooms and 2000P already in production, with total investment over CNY30bn and eventual scale above 100,000P.

name: China Telecom Central China (Zhengzhou Airport) Data Center Comprehensive Production Dispatch Center
notes: Henan public resources notice is a supervision-service candidate announcement for the Zhengzhou Airport data center comprehensive production dispatch center; the project is under Zhengzhou Airport Economy Zone construction supervision.

name: Yudongnan Intelligent Computing Center in Xiangcheng
developer: Xiangcheng Municipal People's Government; Lotus Holdings; China Mobile Henan Zhoukou Branch
notes: Signing report says phase I will use China Mobile Henan Zhoukou Branch's existing machine room and phase II will build new IDC and intelligent-computing center facilities in Lotus Health's park; estimated investment about CNY250m for phase I and CNY350m-CNY400m for phase II.

name: Zhoukou Big Data Industrial Park
developer: Zhoukou municipal / urban-rural integration demonstration area stakeholders; design by HM International
notes: Architecture/project publication describes a Zhoukou Big Data Industrial Park in Chuanhui District intended as an Internet+, big data and cloud-computing cluster platform; no rack or MW capacity stated.

name: Zhumadian Internet Data Center Project
notes: Zhumadian civil-defense administrative license names the Internet Data Center project; local reporting says it was under active construction in January 2024 and is part of the Zhumadian Smart Island project; policy summary says IDC project target completion by end-2025 with total building area 569,423.78 sq m including an office building, data center and smart city management facilities.

name: China Mobile (Enshi) Data Center
notes: Hubei Daily reports the project broke ground in Enshi City's Jinziba area; China Mobile Hubei is investing on an 18 mu site with planned gross floor area 18,000 sq m, phase I about 10,000 sq m, planned June 2024 service, and total plan of 2,250 IDC racks.

name: Wuling Mountain (Lichuan) Intelligent Computing Center Expansion
developer: Lichuan local digital-economy stakeholders / operator not identified in source
notes: Enshi prefecture development-and-reform source reports phase II expansion of Wuling Mountain (Lichuan) Intelligent Computing Center completed, with AI cabinets/GPU servers in the center machine room; no MW capacity stated.

name: Yueke (Hubei) Data Center
developer: Shanghai Huayi Enterprise Group / Yueke (Hubei) Data Center Co.
notes: Echeng District report says Yueke Hubei data center has total investment CNY10bn, 106.6 mu site and about 130,000 sq m GFA; phase I includes data-center buildings, intelligent-computing center, operations command center and 110 kV substation; phase II planned 16,500 compute/storage servers and 30,000P/s after buildout.

name: China Mobile Hubei Intelligent Computing Center
notes: Ezhou Linkong Economic Zone says the project started April 9, 2025; investment CNY300m, 32.16 mu site, 14,261.55 sq m GFA, 700 planned racks, full configuration 860P compute and 185P storage.

name: Wuxue Big Data Center
developer: Wuxue municipal government / Hubei digital government stakeholders
notes: Hubei Data Bureau says Wuxue built Huanggang's first county-level big data center in November 2024, with total investment CNY158m, government-network/business-network/Internet rooms, 220 cabinets and 121 physical servers.

name: Smart Huangshi Cloud Computing Big Data Center
developer: Huangshi municipal government; China Mobile, Hubei Broadcasting Network and Civic Home data centers
notes: Huangshi 14th Five-Year big data/smart city plan says the city built a Smart Huangshi cloud-computing big-data center supported by China Mobile, broadcasting-network and Civic Home data centers; as of August 2021 the cloud platform had 837 VMs carrying 58 municipal business systems.

name: Huangshi Mobile Big Data Center / Huangshi Advanced Intelligent Computing Center
developer: China Mobile Hubei / Huangshi project stakeholders
notes: Regional and industry reports say Huangshi Mobile Big Data Center, Daye Intelligent Computing Center and Yangxin data/intelligent-computing center were under construction; a Huangshi Advanced Intelligent Computing Center phase I filing was reported in November 2024, and C114 said the Hubei Mobile Huangshi big data center main structure had topped out.
